title: Compare Treatment Costs: India vs USA vs UAE
altText: treatment cost comparison India USA UAE, medical tourism cost
introduction: Many international patients choose India for high-quality treatment at a fraction of the cost. This guide provides a transparent cost comparison for major treatments, helping patients make informed decisions.

sections.title: Cost Comparison Table
points: Heart Surgery (Bypass): $5,000 – $8,000 in India vs $70,000 – $120,000 in USA (85% savings)
Knee Replacement: $4,000 – $6,000 in India vs $35,000 – $50,000 in USA (80% savings)
IVF & Fertility: $2,000 – $5,000 in India vs $12,000 – $20,000 in USA (75% savings)
Liver Transplant: $45,000 – $60,000 in India vs $250,000 – $400,000 in USA (85% savings)
Cancer Treatment: $5,000 – $15,000 in India vs $100,000 – $200,000 in USA (85% savings)

sections.title: Why India is Affordable
points: Lower hospital costs: Advanced facilities at competitive prices
Skilled specialists: High-quality care without high overhead
Comprehensive support: Patient coordinators, accommodation, and follow-up services

title: Frequently Asked Questions About Medical Tourism in India
altText: medical tourism FAQs India, international patient questions
introduction: International patients often have many questions before traveling to India for medical care. This FAQ guide provides clear answers about treatment, costs, travel, and patient services.

sections.title: FAQs
points: Q1: Which treatments are popular for international patients in India? – Cardiology, Orthopedic Surgery, Cancer Treatment, IVF & Fertility, Liver & Kidney Transplants.
Q2: How much can I save by choosing India for medical treatment? – Patients typically save 60–85% compared to the USA, UK, or UAE.
Q3: How do I apply for a medical visa to India? – Submit your passport, hospital admission letter, and doctor referral to the Indian embassy or consulate.
Q4: Will I get help with travel and accommodation? – Yes, partner hospitals provide airport pickup, transfers, and nearby accommodation.
Q5: Can I have follow-up consultations after returning home? – Many hospitals offer telemedicine and online follow-up services.
Q6: Are the hospitals internationally accredited? – Yes, partner hospitals are NABH or JCI accredited.
